items.title: What Is Solventum (SOLV) Signaling With Its 90% Separation And HIS Split Plan?
items.summary: Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) reports that more than 90% of its separation from former parent 3M is now complete. The healthcare supplier has executed its largest ever ERP cutover, consolidating core systems into a new standalone platform. Management has renegotiated a raw material supply agreement with 3M and plans to separate the Health Information Systems business for clearer focus.
